# Native policy-tagged frequency lifecycles

This immutable fixture contains 298 positive schedules and 4065 complete states
from unchanged pinned zstd v1.5.7 functions. Both policies are explicit; every
original whole-mode request retains its source and operation values. Two rejected
fractional wrappers remain in the source-only manifest and original capture.
Normal and fully instrumented native transcripts match and are independently
replayed before projection. See `provenance.json` for all exact identities.

`ZUFRQF01` contains a u32 count, then case headers, names, source bytes, six-word
operations and 390-word complete observations. Total size is 26,646,439 bytes.
Names/source bytes are borrowed by the Rust reader; observation allocation is
bounded and fallible. Extra-bit widths and initial distributions derive from
pinned zstd sources, with attribution in NOTICE/LICENSE.zstd.

The independent Python checker reconstructs every byte without native execution
or production Rust. Malformed controls are retained as verified lossless deltas
against the immutable baseline. This corpus qualifies frequency lifecycle and
scalar prices; it does not establish Ultra path or public frame support.
